operation.name: GetGrievanceByStatus
operation.query: with CTE(status, countValue) as ( select status, count(*) as [Count] from ( select NEWID() as id , Status from NonGBVMain where deleted = 0 union select NEWID() as id, status from GBVMain where deleted = 0 ) as test group by status ) select s.StatusName as PropertyName , cte.countValue as PropertyValue1, format( (convert(decimal, cte.countValue) / convert(int, (select sum(countValue) from cte)) ),'P') as PropertyValue2 from cte as cte inner join LK_GBVStatus as s on s.StatusID = cte.status

operation.name: GetGrievanceByTypeGBV_NonGBV
operation.query:
with CTE(TypeName, countValue) as ( select TypeName, CountValue from ( select 'Non-GBV' as TypeName, count(*) as CountValue from NonGBVMain where deleted = 0 union select 'GBV' as TypeName, count(*) as CountValue from GBVMain where deleted = 0 ) as test
) select typename as PropertyName, countValue as PropertyValue1, format( (convert(decimal, cte.countValue) / convert(int, (select sum(countValue) from cte)) ),'P') as PropertyValue2 from cte

operation.name: GetNon_GBVGrievanceByType
operation.query: with CTE(TypeName, countValue) as ( select tg.Name , count(*) as CountValue from NonGBVMain as g inner join LK_TypeOfGrievance as tg on tg.TypeOfGrievanceID = g.TypeOfGrievanceID where deleted = 0 group by tg.Name ) select typename as PropertyName, countValue as PropertyValue1, format( (convert(decimal, cte.countValue) / convert(int, (select sum(countValue) from cte)) ),'P') as PropertyValue2 from cte

operation.name: GetGrievancesByProgram
operation.query:
with CTE(Programme, countValue) as ( select Programmet, sum(countvalue) as PropertyValue1 from
( select 'SSSNP' as ProgrammeT, count(*) as CountValue from NonGBVMain where deleted = 0 union select 'SSSNP'as programmeT,count(*) as CountValue from GBVMain where deleted = 0 ) as tmp group by tmp.Programmet )
select Programme as PropertyName, countValue as PropertyValue1, format( (convert(decimal, cte.countValue) / convert(int, (select sum(countValue) from cte)) ),'P') as PropertyValue2 from cte

operation.name: GetGrievancesByLocationAndType
operation.query: with CTE(LocationName,GrType, countValue,FemaleCount,MaleCount) as ( select Countiename, GRtype, total,FemaleCount,MaleCount from (select CountieName, 'GBV' as GrType, count(g.GBVMainID) as total ,SUM(case when (gender ='F' or gender='Female') then 1 else 0 end ) as FemaleCount ,SUM(case when (gender ='M' or gender='Male') then 1 else 0 end) as MaleCount from GBVMain g inner join tm_counties c on c.intCountieid=g.CountyID where deleted=0 --and Gender is not null and Gender <>'' and Gender <>'0' group by CountieName union select CountieName, 'NGBV' as GrType, count(ng.nonGBVMainID) as total ,SUM(case when (gender ='F' or gender='Female') then 1 else 0 end ) as FemaleCount ,SUM(case when (gender ='M' or gender='Male') then 1 else 0 end) as MaleCount from nonGBVMain ng inner join tm_counties c on c.intCountieid=ng.CountyID where deleted=0 --and Gender is not null and Gender <>'' and Gender <>'0' group by CountieName ) as GrTemp ) select LocationName as PropertyName , GrType as PropertyValue1 ,countValue as PropertyValue2 ,format((convert(decimal, cte.countValue) / convert(int, (select sum(countValue) from cte))),'P') as PropertyValue3 ,format((convert(decimal,MaleCount)/Convert(decimal,(FemaleCount+MaleCount))),'P') as PropertyValue4 ,format((convert(decimal,FemaleCount)/Convert(decimal,(FemaleCount+MaleCount))),'P') as PropertyValue5 from cte order by PropertyName

operation.name: GetGBVByProgramStatus
operation.query: with CTE(program, status, countValue) as ( select 'SSSNP',status, count(*) as [Count] from ( select NEWID() as id, status from GBVMain where deleted = 0 ) as tmp group by status ) select program as PropertyName, s.StatusName as PropertyValue1, cte.countValue as PropertyValue2, format( (convert(decimal, cte.countValue) / convert(int, (select sum(countValue) from cte)) ),'P') as PropertyValue3 from cte as cte inner join LK_GBVStatus as s on s.StatusID = cte.status

operation.name: GetSSNPRelatedComplaintLog
operation.query: select Countiename as PropertyName ,format([date],'dd/MM/yyyy') as PropertyValue1 ,Statusname as PropertyValue2 ,gender as PropertyValue3 ,AgeOfSurvivor as PropertyValue4 from gbvmain gbv inner join tm_counties c on gbv.CountyID=c.intCountieid inner join LK_GBVStatus lkStatus on gbv.Status=lkstatus.StatusID where deleted=0 and SuspectAssociatedWithProject=1

operation.name: GetAgeBreakdownSSSNP
GetGBVLocationAgeGroup
operation.query:
with CTE(LocationId, countValue) as ( select g.CountyID as LocationID , count(*) as CountValue
from GBVMain as g inner join tm_Counties as c on c.intCountieid = g.CountyID where deleted = 0 group by g.CountyID
) select tc.CountieName as PropertyName, countValue as PropertyValue1, format( (convert(decimal, c.countValue) / convert(int, (select sum(countValue) from cte)) ),'P') as PropertyValue2 ,( select count(*) from GBVMain where AgeOfSurvivor <=17 and CountyID = c.LocationId ) as PropertyValue3
from cte as c inner join tm_Counties as tc on tc.intCountieid = c.LocationId

operation.name: GetResolutionTimes
operation.query:
with CTE(TypeName,GRType ,countValue) as (
select '15 Days or less','GBV', count(*) as CountValue from GBVMain as G left join GBVDetails as d on g.GBVMainID=d.GBVMainID where g.deleted = 0 and (d.Deleted is null or d.Deleted=0) and datediff(day, g.date, (isnull(g.StatusLastModificationDate, d.LastModificationTimestamp))) <=15 and g.Status = 5 union select '15 Days or less','NGBV', count(*) as CountValue from nonGBVMain as G left join nonGBVDetails as d on g.NonGBVMainID=d.NonGBVMainID where g.deleted = 0 and (d.Deleted is null or d.Deleted=0) and datediff(day, g.date, d.DataOfResolution) <=15 and g.Status = 5 union
select '16 Days or more','GBV', count(*) as CountValue from GBVMain as G left join GBVDetails as d on g.GBVMainID=d.GBVMainID where g.deleted = 0 and (d.Deleted is null or d.Deleted=0) and datediff(day, g.date, (isnull(g.StatusLastModificationDate, d.LastModificationTimestamp))) > 15 and g.Status = 5 union select '16 Days or more','NGBV', count(*) as CountValue from nonGBVMain as G left join nonGBVDetails as d on g.NonGBVMainID=d.NonGBVMainID where g.deleted = 0 and (d.Deleted is null or d.Deleted=0) and datediff(day, g.date, d.DataOfResolution) > 15 and g.Status = 5 ) select typename as PropertyName, GRType as PropertyValue1,countValue as PropertyValue2, CASE countValue WHEN 0 THEN FORMAT(0,'P') ELSE format( (convert(decimal, cte.countValue) / convert(int, (select sum(countValue) from cte)) ),'P') END as PropertyValue3 from cte

operation.name: GetAverageResolutionTimeByLocation
operation.query:
select countiename as PropertyName , 'Non-GBV' as PropertyValue1 ,(sum(datediff(day, n.DateOfComplaint , d.DataOfResolution))/count(*)) as PropertyValue2
from nonGBVMain as n inner join NonGBVDetails as d on (n.NonGBVMainID = d.NonGBVMainID and d.Deleted = 0) inner join tm_Counties on n.CountyID=tm_counties.intCountieid where n.Deleted=0 and n.status=5 group by countiename order by countiename

operation.name: DelayedGrievanceByType
operation.query: select 'GBV' as PropertyName, count(*) as PropertyValue from GBVMain where Deleted=0 and status<>5 and datediff(day,isnull(statuslastmodificationdate, lastmodificationtimestamp), getdate())>15 union select 'NGBV' as PropertyName, count(*) as PropertyValue from nonGBVMain where Deleted=0 and status<>5 and datediff(day,isnull(statuslastmodificationdate, lastmodificationtimestamp), getdate())>15
